The '''Mengal system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that was the site of a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Mengal system listening post|listening post]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The listening post intercepted coded [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial messages]] that led to the capture of an Imperial cargo [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] passing through the region.<ref name="TOR" />
